label: Density curves
subgoals: A density curve is nonnegative and encloses total area one.
Probability corresponds to area under the curve.

label: Probability as area
subgoals: An interval probability is a definite integral over that interval.

label: The normal density
subgoals: The normal density is a bell-shaped curve centred at its mean.
The area within one standard deviation is about 68 percent.
